title: 密碼鎖
question: 家門的密碼鎖密碼是 1234。請一直輸入密碼，錯了輸出「密碼錯誤」再輸入一次；對了輸出「開門」，結束程式。

test_case.output:
密碼錯誤
密碼錯誤
開門

en.title: Door Lock
en.question: The door code is 1234. Keep inputting a code. If it is wrong, output "Wrong code" and try again. If it is right, output "Open" and stop.

test_case.note: Wrong twice, right the third time
